_comment: FICTIONAL DEMO DATA. Every claim, number and organization below is invented to demonstrate the ledger format.
change_note: 2026-01-05 (revision 2026-01-05.1): demo ledger created for the example persona. Previous: none.
authority: Only claims with status 'usable' may be used. Reflections carry motives and personal details in the user's own words.

bikeshare.purpose.text: A course capstone for a city parks department that wanted to staff and stock its bike-share stations ahead of demand, by predicting daily rentals from weather and the calendar.
bikeshare.purpose.source: Jordan's answer in the evidence interview, 2026-01-03 (fictional)
bikeshare.purpose.ownership: team capstone (four students); Jordan one of four
bikeshare.purpose.limitations: A capstone for the department, not a deployed system. The department's own staffing decisions are not claimed.

bikeshare.how.text: Built the feature pipeline and evaluation harness in Python (pandas, scikit-learn) for a gradient-boosted daily-rental model, joining three years of station logs with weather and holiday data.
bikeshare.how.source: Jordan's answer in the evidence interview, 2026-01-03 (fictional); capstone report section 4
bikeshare.how.ownership: personal: feature pipeline and evaluation harness; teammates built the dashboard and the baseline model
bikeshare.how.limitations: Model tuning was shared. Do not claim the dashboard.

bikeshare.result.text: Cut mean absolute error from 41 to 29 rentals per day against a seasonal-average baseline on a held-out final month.
bikeshare.result.ownership: team result; Jordan produced the evaluation
bikeshare.result.limitations: One held-out month, one city. A model error on a test month, not a realized operational saving.

pantry.purpose.text: A personal project to cut food waste at home: a small web app that suggests meals from what is already in the pantry.
pantry.purpose.limitations: Used only by Jordan and household. No other users.

pantry.how.text: Built the app end to end with Flask and SQLite, including recipe matching by ingredient overlap and 40 unit tests.

pantry.result.text: Matched suggestions to pantry contents for a hand-entered set of 120 recipes, with unit tests covering the matching and expiry rules.
pantry.result.limitations: A functioning personal tool. No claim about food saved or users.

library.purpose.text: A course project in natural language processing that asked whether a retrieval-based assistant could answer a university library's common questions better than keyword search.
library.purpose.source: Jordan's answer in the evidence interview, 2026-01-03 (fictional)
library.purpose.limitations: A course experiment. The library did not adopt or deploy it.

library.how.text: Built a retrieval pipeline in Python with sentence embeddings and a FAISS index over 85 library FAQ pages, and a scoring script for answer correctness.
library.how.source: Jordan's answer in the evidence interview, 2026-01-03 (fictional)
library.how.limitations: Retrieval and scoring were Jordan's; answer text came from an off-the-shelf language model.

library.result.text: Answered 41 of 60 hand-written test questions correctly with embedding retrieval versus 29 of 60 with keyword search.
library.result.limitations: Small hand-written test set judged by one reviewer (Jordan). Not a general accuracy figure.

registrar.report.text: Replaced a manual weekly enrollment report with a Python script that produces the same tables, cutting the preparation step from about an hour to a few minutes.
registrar.report.source: Jordan's answer in the evidence interview, 2026-01-03 (fictional)
registrar.report.limitations: The time figures are Jordan's own estimates. The office's wider reporting is not claimed.

motive.next_role.text: Wants a first role where the analysis feeds a real decision and a more experienced person reviews the work, so the skills grow quickly.

pantry.motive.text: Built the Pantry Planner because food kept going bad at home and a spreadsheet was not getting used.

unresolved: Whether the capstone report may be shared publicly (client permission) - ask before linking it.
